#232

- Growing alone on fallen hardwood log on a north-facing woodland slope in a transitional zone between riparian and oak/hickory woodland.
- Cap conical with darker red center, striated and scalloped margin.
- Stipe reddish, darker towards base, only exuding dark liquid when squeezed.
